_note: Verified from the Box2Fit White Rock Google Business Profile (screenshots provided by client). Quotes are VERBATIM — do not paraphrase. Attribute as first name + initial. 'audience' tags which campaign segment each quote suits.

reviews.name: Nadia G.
reviews.quote: My mom and I joined Box2Fit a little over a month ago, and it's truly one of the best decisions we've made! The coaches are incredibly encouraging, welcoming, and kind.

reviews.name: Deanna R.
reviews.quote: My husband and I wanted to try something different than your regular gym workout and let me tell you it has been worth every moment and penny.

reviews.name: Michelle A.
reviews.quote: My son loves the BOX2FIT kids class! All the trainers have been great with him. It's a welcoming and supportive environment. He is always excited to go.

reviews.name: Kathleen C.
reviews.quote: My son is very sheltered and extremely hard to motivate. She got my son out of his shell and is super enthusiastic for his next class and to grow in boxing.

reviews.name: Lindsey K.
reviews.quote: My son has been doing the boxing classes for kids for just over a year now and he loves it! I have seen an improvement in all the other sports he does.

reviews.name: Pro K.
reviews.quote: After a long time my son is finally enjoying, learning, and getting a proper workout! I highly recommend this place for all ages.

reviews.name: Elena G.
reviews.quote: I entered the boxing world not knowing anything and the first lesson I felt wonderful. Everything was explained thoroughly, making it a non-stressful and fun environment. 10/10 would recommend!

reviews.name: Alana K.
reviews.quote: Wonderful environment whether you're a beginner or have experience. Esmeralda makes each session a challenge while keeping the fun!

reviews.name: Michael B.
reviews.quote: Perfect place for anyone wanting to learn how to box or simply have fun and have an amazing workout! No experience needed.

reviews.name: G. A.
reviews.quote: Box2Fit is the best boxing gym! The coaches are amazing and you get a killer workout in a safe and comfortable environment.

reviews.name: Faraz N.
reviews.quote: Box2Fit is a knockout! The best workouts, top-notch coaches! Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Dan B.
reviews.quote: Best boxing gym in Surrey! Will take you from beginner to advanced while learning how to box properly and efficiently. 100% recommend.

reviews.name: Sandcastle F.
reviews.quote: Amazing classes, helped me get in my best shape in years. Coach Esmeralda has such great energy and is very motivating.
